summary_oneline: Lazy-load output writers (PDFWriter/weasyprint first) so QS and the HTTP service stop paying ~0.45 s at import

localization.role: eager import of all writer classes
package init pulls output.py on any outputs.* import

claims.claim: weasyprint is the only writer dependency with material import cost (~440-610 ms); other writers <3 ms
weasyprint is loaded in both library mode (queries.qs) and HTTP mode (services) before any PDF is requested
The WRITERS class is only needed at DataOutput.response time, so resolution can be deferred
Tests require WRITERS to stay a module-level mutable mapping that accepts classes via setitem
Moving the weasyprint import into get_response is behaviour-neutral
Expected saving is ~27% of `import querysource.queries.qs` wall time on the dev machine
The sync write_pdf call blocks the event loop and can be offloaded with asyncio.to_thread

unknowns.question: Scope: PDF-only, lazy registry for all writers, or also decouple the outputs package?
Keep WeasyPrint as a hard dependency or move it to an extra?
Include the blocking write_pdf → to_thread fix?

recommended_next_command.rationale: Localization is complete and measured, all design forks are resolved by the user, and the change is bounded to querysource/outputs/.
